info.name: Ejada E-commerce (Gateway)
info.description:
End-to-end API for the Ejada e-commerce microservices, all through the API gateway.

AUTH MODEL:
- Public: register, login, refresh, GET products (shop & inventory), /actuator/health.
- Authenticated (Bearer access token): wallet, cart, orders — ownership enforced (self or admin).
- Admin only: create admin users, and create/update/delete products.

USAGE: run '1. Auth > Register (user)' (sets token & userId), and 'Login (admin)' (sets adminToken). Then create a product (sets productId/sku), add to cart, and checkout.

All services are reachable ONLY through the gateway; direct calls are blocked by a shared internal key.

item.name: 1. Auth

request.description: Public. Anyone can self-register as ROLE_USER. Also opens a wallet (best-effort). Captures token, refreshToken, userId.
Exchange a refresh token for a new access token.
ADMIN ONLY. Only an admin can create another admin. role = ROLE_USER or ROLE_ADMIN.

item.description: Authentication and user management. register/login/refresh are public; admin/users is admin-only.

item.name: 2. Wallet

request.description: Self or admin. reference is optional.
Ledger history for the wallet. Self or admin.
Normally called by auth-service during registration. Included for completeness.
Internal: used by shop checkout to charge the wallet.

item.description: Wallet balance and transactions. Every /{userId} route is guarded so a user can only touch their own wallet (admins can touch any).

item.name: 3. Shop - Products

request.description: ADMIN ONLY. initialStock (optional, default 0) also registers the product in inventory so it is immediately buyable. Captures productId & sku.
ADMIN ONLY. Full-object replace; send every field you want to keep. Propagates price/name/photo to inventory.
ADMIN ONLY. Partial update — send only the fields you want to change (e.g. just price and/or imageUrl). Propagates to inventory. Does not touch stock.

item.description: Product catalog. GET is public; POST/PUT/DELETE require an admin token (enforced at the gateway).

item.name: 4. Shop - Cart
item.description: Shopping cart, keyed by userId. Ownership enforced.

item.name: 5. Shop - Orders

request.description: Reserves stock in inventory, debits the wallet, confirms the reservation. 201 on success; 422 if stock/funds insufficient. Captures orderId.
Self or admin (by the order's owner).

item.description: Checkout orchestrates inventory + wallet across services.

item.name: 6. Inventory - Products

request.description: ADMIN ONLY. Usually created automatically via shop product creation.
ADMIN ONLY. delta may be negative (cannot go below 0).

item.description: Inventory catalog + stock. GET public; mutations admin-only.

item.name: 7. Inventory - Reservations

request.description: Internal: used by checkout. HELD on success, FAILED if not enough stock.

item.description: Reservation lifecycle. Normally driven by shop checkout, not called directly.

item.name: 9. E2E Smoke Flow

request.description: Run this whole folder top-to-bottom (folder ▶ Run, or the Collection Runner). Each step asserts and feeds the next.

exec: pm.test('checkout 201 + PAID', function(){ pm.response.to.have.status(201); var d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(d.payment.status).to.eql('SUCCESS'); });

item.description: Full end-to-end smoke: admin management + shopper purchase, top-to-bottom with assertions. Run the folder (▶ Run) against the Render or Local environment. On the free tier, wake the services first (Health & Security → Gateway health returns 200) so nothing times out cold.
